# Reception Perception: The Show — 2024-02-29

**Raw transcript:** `raw/ingested/reception-perception/2024-02-29-rp-wide-receiver-prospects-the-state-of-the-falcons.md` (immutable — do not edit)

## Summary

An unusual format episode: [[Matt Harmon]] took the week off, so **James Koh**
(co-host — not a tracked expert) hosts solo with two guests, neither a
tracked expert. No Harmon opinion appears anywhere in this episode.

**Segment 1 — second-tier 2024 WR prospects**, with guest **Eric Froton**
(college football analyst, NBC Sports, 2024 FSWA College Sports Writer of
the Year — not tracked), recorded at the NFL Combine. Deep evaluative dive
on four 6'3"+ receivers outside the consensus top three ([[Marvin Harrison
Jr.]], [[Malik Nabers]], [[Rome Odunze]]): [[Keon Coleman]], [[Brian Thomas
Jr.]], [[Xavier Legette]] and [[Adonai Mitchell]], plus shorter hits on
[[Troy Franklin]], [[Malachi Corley]], [[Ja'Lynn Polk]] (ASR: "Jalen Polk"),
Jalen McMillan and [[Xavier Worthy]]. Froton picks Thomas as the highest
upside of the four, Coleman as most pro-ready, and floats Legette as the
group's likeliest bust risk.

**Segment 2 — Atlanta Falcons temperature check**, with guest **Kevin
Knight** (Falcons reporter, SB Nation's *Falcoholic* — not tracked), his
first appearance on the show. Covers Atlanta's league-worst 2024 WR spend
($8.5M), the thin receiver room beyond [[Drake London]], speculation on
[[Malik Nabers]]/[[Rome Odunze]] falling to pick 8, day-two WR targets
([[Ja'Lynn Polk]], [[Roman Wilson]]), free-agent WR names (Michael Pittman,
Calvin Ridley, Tyler Boyd, Josh Reynolds, Darnell Mooney, KhaDarel Hodge,
Van Jefferson — none tracked-expert evaluative, not given pages), the
Atlanta QB search ([[Justin Fields]] trade buzz, [[Kirk Cousins]] fit,
[[Michael Penix Jr.]] and [[J.J. McCarthy]] as draft options, a [[Drake
Maye]] trade-up fantasy deemed very unlikely — not given its own bullet),
[[Bijan Robinson]]'s frustrating 2023 usage, and [[Kyle Pitts]]'s health.
